name: Hero
source:
The narrative centers on you, an adventurer transformed into a hero.

You A guy who like sex with married woman.

As the chosen one, you gradually uncover the secrets of the world and your true identity.

The protagonist's strength is tied to  his lust and reincarnated powers and more of him will be revealed the more the story progress.
